posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
We definitely aren't interested in making SotM themed sleeves (we've talked about it a bunch) because we put information on both sides of our cards. Any sort of sleeves with printing would cover one side. That's not ok. Entirely clear sleeves is the way to go.

(That is, if you sleeve at all. And hey, if that's your thing, don't let my personal prejudices get in your way!)
